title: Goh Joo Hin - Virtual Mall
designStyle: A freely walkable third-person shopping world with a dusk skylight, jade marble, warm brass, real-scale stores and source-verified brand displays.
disclaimer: Independent, unofficial design concept. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Goh Joo Hin Pte Ltd.
summary: Walk, run and explore one continuous mall with an animated character, physical collisions, opening storefronts and verified New Moon, MILI and GOGO displays. Includes an accessible store directory.
